evidence.quote: Thank you to Professor Scott for inviting me to join this discussion on cross-border resolution and risks of fragmentation.

I believe we should consider whether the internal TLAC calibration for IHCs could be adjusted to reflect the practice of other regulators without adversely affecting resolvability and U.S. financial stability.
We are committed to working with other jurisdictions to continue to build the foundation of the SPOE resolution framework.
